question: Why does activity designated as merit produce repeated diverse births that make one a vessel of affliction?
premises: one remains always a receptacle of affliction
inference: Merit-driven activity does not liberate; it perpetuates diverse births and suffering.
uncertainties: the exact antecedent of yaiḥ is not explicit in this verse alone
plain_english: By which one is always a receptacle of affliction in births of various forms.
